turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I need to pick hiking boots before my trip, and I've tried on a few pairs.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm going to list all the options first, so please don't comment until I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first pair is heavy leather boots, super sturdy and waterproof, but they need breaking in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The second pair is lightweight trail runners, really comfortable right away, but not waterproof.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the third pair is mid height synthetic boots, kind of in between, with decent ankle support.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's all I've got. Which would you choose?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: What kind of terrain and weather are you expecting? If it's wet and rocky, go for the leather boots, but start wearing them now. If it's dry, the trail runners will feel amazing.
